title: Fill the gaps
summary: Sentences with a word missing, filled from a word bank.
description: Sentences recalled one word at a time, in their context.

requirements.text: A fill-the-gaps card holds up to four of the lesson's sentences of three words or more, each with one word missing.
The missing word is one the course teaches where a sentence has one; otherwise its longest word.
The word bank holds the missing words and two that do not belong.
A card is made only when at least two sentences have a gap.
